settings.label: Console mode
settings.note: The mode the game sees: the TV picture of the docked console or the screen of the handheld. Games made for the touch screen work best in handheld mode.

settings.label: Full screen
settings.note: The window starts in full screen.

settings.label: Pause in the background
settings.note: The game pauses when its window loses the focus.

settings.label: Home menu
settings.note: A short press of the controller's Home button opens the Home menu.

settings.label: Hold Home to quit
settings.note: Holding the controller's Home button for 2 seconds asks whether to quit the game.
